name: Mutation too small
lesson: Gaussian steps of σ = 0.005 are too small to carry the population out of a local minimum.
lookFor: This is the Rastrigin landscape with σ = 0.005 instead of 0.05. With this seed the population collapses and the best so far after 100 generations is −4.97 (f = 4.97) at (2, 1), a local minimum far from the global one; the diversity is 0.002. The same seed with σ = 0.05 reaches the global minimum in generation 19. With seeds 1 to 100, 13 runs reach ε with σ = 0.005 against 81 with σ = 0.05.
